rows.definition: Construct the agent Planner for an Inkling 2 model whose weights are bound to a compute backend device (CUDA), so prefill and decode run on that device instead of the host loop.
rows.distinction: Same request adapter as the host run planner, but carries the device backend the weights live on; it binds no weights itself and plans no memory placement.

rows.definition: Size every device upload the Inkling 2 CUDA bind would make, choose which expert stacks stay VRAM-resident under the budget, and tier the cold stacks into RAM or NVMe, returning the RAM-tier regions to prefetch.
rows.distinction: A memory-placement plan for weights, computed before any upload; distinct from the agent run planners, which adapt an already bound model to generation requests.

rows.definition: Consume one prompt token on the Inkling 2 loop host, updating attention and convolution state, and return logits only when it is the final prompt position.
rows.distinction: The per-token prompt path with dispatch-panic recovery; the batch prefill consumes the whole prompt at once and a decode step consumes one sampled token with logits every time.

rows.definition: The GGUF general.architecture string of the looped Inkling 2 family (inkling2_loop), also the model_type its served config carries.
rows.distinction: A constant architecture label used for routing and config; the IsInkling2Loop predicate tests a file against it, and the loop model family row names the model itself.
